points.title: 音乐启蒙
points.description: 朱塞佩·威尔第于1813年10月10日出生于意大利北部布塞托附近的小村庄隆科莱。他的父亲是当地一家旅馆的老板兼屠夫，母亲是纺纱工。威尔第从小就展现出对音乐的浓厚兴趣，在乡村教堂合唱团中唱歌。1823年，他开始在布塞托的中学学习，并得到当地富商安东尼奥·巴雷兹的资助。巴雷兹认识到威尔第的音乐天赋，安排他跟随当地音乐家普罗韦西学习音乐理论和钢琴。这段早期教育为威尔第未来的歌剧创作奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: Giuseppe Verdi was born on October 10, 1813, in the small village of Roncole near Busseto in northern Italy. His father was an innkeeper and butcher, while his mother was a weaver. From an early age, Verdi showed a strong interest in music, singing in the local church choir. In 1823, he began his secondary education in Busseto and received financial support from a wealthy local merchant, Antonio Barezzi, who recognized Verdi's musical talent. Barezzi arranged for Verdi to study music theory and piano with local musician Provesi. This early education laid the foundation for Verdi's future opera compositions.

points.title: 音乐学院深造
points.description: 1832年，威尔第申请米兰音乐学院被拒绝后，他转而跟随私人教师学习，包括著名声乐教师拉维尼亚和歌剧作曲家文琴佐·拉维尼亚。在米兰，威尔第接触到了当时最先进的歌剧作品，特别是罗西尼和多尼采蒂的作品。1836年，威尔第与资助人巴雷兹的女儿玛格丽塔结婚，这段婚姻对威尔第的生活产生了深远影响。1838年，威尔第创作了他的第一部歌剧《奥贝托》，这部作品于1839年在米兰斯卡拉歌剧院首演并获得成功，为他赢得了声誉和与米兰歌剧院的合约。
points.descriptionEn: After being rejected by the Milan Conservatory in 1832, Verdi studied privately with renowned vocal teacher Lavigna and opera composer Vincenzo Lavigna. In Milan, Verdi was exposed to the most advanced opera works of the time, particularly those by Rossini and Donizetti. In 1836, Verdi married Margherita Barezzi, the daughter of his patron, a marriage that profoundly affected his life. In 1838, Verdi composed his first opera, 'Oberto', which premiered successfully at Milan's La Scala theater in 1839, earning him recognition and a contract with the opera house.

points.title: 早期歌剧创作
points.description: 这一时期是威尔第创作的黄金时期，他创作了一系列具有革命性的歌剧作品。1842年，他的歌剧《纳布科》在斯卡拉歌剧院首演，其中的合唱曲《飞吧，思念，乘着金色的翅膀》成为意大利统一运动的象征。1844年的《厄尔南尼》和1847年的《麦克白》进一步巩固了他的声誉。然而，这一时期威尔第也经历了个人悲剧，他的妻子和两个孩子相继去世，这些悲剧深刻影响了他的创作风格，使他的音乐更加深沉和富有情感。1849年，威尔第购买了布斯托附近的圣阿加塔庄园，这里成为他后半生的主要居所和创作基地。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked Verdi's golden age of composition, during which he created a series of revolutionary operas. In 1842, his opera 'Nabucco' premiered at La Scala, with its chorus 'Va, pensiero' becoming a symbol of the Italian unification movement. 'Ernani' (1844) and 'Macbeth' (1847) further solidified his reputation. However, Verdi also experienced personal tragedies during this time, with his wife and two children dying in succession. These tragedies profoundly influenced his compositional style, making his music more profound and emotionally charged. In 1849, Verdi purchased the Sant'Agata estate near Busseto, which became his main residence and creative base for the rest of his life.

points.title: 创作巅峰期
points.description: 这一时期威尔第创作了他最著名的作品，包括《茶花女》(1853)、《弄臣》(1853)、《游吟诗人》(1853)和《命运之力》(1862)。这些作品展现了威尔第对人物心理的深刻洞察力和音乐戏剧性的完美掌控。1861年，威尔第被选为意大利王国国会议员，积极参与国家政治事务。1869年，他创作了《安魂曲》，纪念好友、作家亚历山德罗·曼佐尼。1871年，威尔第创作了《唐卡洛斯》，这部作品在巴黎首演，进一步扩大了他的国际声誉。在这一时期，威尔第逐渐从公众视野中淡出，更多地在圣阿加塔庄园度过时光，专注于创作和经营自己的农业产业。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Verdi created his most famous works, including 'La Traviata' (1853), 'Rigoletto' (1853), 'Il Trovatore' (1853), and 'La Forza del Destino' (1862). These works demonstrated Verdi's profound insight into human psychology and his mastery of musical drama. In 1861, Verdi was elected as a senator in the Kingdom of Italy, actively participating in national political affairs. In 1869, he composed the 'Requiem' in memory of his friend, writer Alessandro Manzoni. In 1871, Verdi created 'Don Carlos', which premiered in Paris, further expanding his international reputation. During this time, Verdi gradually withdrew from public view, spending more time at his Sant'Agata estate, focusing on composition and managing his agricultural enterprises.

points.title: 晚年创作与遗产
points.description: 威尔第晚年的创作风格更加成熟和内省。1874年，他的《安魂曲》在米兰首演，这部作品被认为是19世纪最重要的宗教音乐作品之一。1887年，威尔第创作了《奥赛罗》，这部作品基于莎士比亚的悲剧，标志着他歌剧创作的巅峰。1893年，他创作了最后一部歌剧《法尔斯塔夫》，这部喜歌剧展现了他晚年的幽默和智慧。除了歌剧创作，威尔第还致力于意大利音乐教育，资助米兰音乐学院的建设。1901年1月27日，威尔第在米兰去世，享年87岁。他的葬礼成为国家事件，数万人参加送葬仪式。威尔第的遗产不仅包括他创作的26部歌剧，还包括他对意大利民族意识的贡献和对音乐戏剧艺术的革新。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Verdi's compositional style became more mature and introspective. In 1874, his 'Requiem' premiered in Milan, considered one of the most important sacred music works of the 19th century. In 1887, Verdi created 'Otello', based on Shakespeare's tragedy, marking the pinnacle of his operatic career. In 1893, he composed his final opera, 'Falstaff', a comic opera showcasing his late-life humor and wisdom. Beyond opera composition, Verdi dedicated himself to Italian music education, funding the construction of the Milan Conservatory. Verdi died in Milan on January 27, 1901, at the age of 87. His funeral became a national event, with tens of thousands attending. Verdi's legacy includes not only his 26 operas but also his contribution to Italian national consciousness and his innovations in musical dramatic art.

supporter.zh: 威尔第被尊为意大利歌剧的伟大革新者，他的作品深刻影响了歌剧艺术的发展。支持者认为威尔第通过音乐完美地表达了人类情感，使歌剧从单纯的娱乐形式提升为深刻的艺术表达。他的音乐旋律优美动人，人物刻画深刻，戏剧冲突强烈，尤其是《茶花女》、《弄臣》和《奥赛罗》等作品，至今仍是世界各大歌剧院的保留剧目。威尔第还被视为意大利民族统一的象征，他的音乐唤起了意大利人民的民族自豪感和爱国热情，对意大利国家的形成产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Verdi is revered as a great innovator of Italian opera, and his works profoundly influenced the development of operatic art. Supporters believe that Verdi perfectly expressed human emotions through music, elevating opera from mere entertainment to profound artistic expression. His melodies are beautiful and moving, his characterizations are profound, and his dramatic conflicts are intense. Works such as 'La Traviata', 'Rigoletto', and 'Otello' remain staples in major opera houses worldwide. Verdi is also seen as a symbol of Italian unification, as his music awakened national pride and patriotism among Italians, having a profound impact on the formation of the Italian nation.

critic.zh: 批评者指出威尔第的歌剧创作存在一定的局限性，尤其是在音乐创新方面相对保守。他的作品虽然情感丰富，但在和声和配器上相对传统，缺乏瓦格纳等同时代作曲家的革命性创新。此外，威尔第的歌剧常被批评为过于迎合当时观众的口味，缺乏真正的艺术冒险精神。在政治方面，威尔第虽然支持意大利统一，但他的政治立场相对温和，有时被批评为过于妥协。他的晚年作品也被一些评论家认为缺乏早期作品的活力和激情，显示出创作力的衰退。
critic.en: Critics point out certain limitations in Verdi's operatic compositions, particularly regarding musical innovation, which they consider relatively conservative compared to his contemporaries like Wagner. While his works are emotionally rich, they are often seen as conventional in harmony and orchestration, lacking the revolutionary innovations of other composers. Additionally, Verdi's operas have been criticized for catering too much to contemporary audience tastes, lacking true artistic冒险精神. Politically, although Verdi supported Italian unification, his stance was relatively moderate, sometimes criticized as too compromising. His later works have also been viewed by some critics as lacking the vitality and passion of his earlier compositions, suggesting a decline in creative energy.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，威尔第被公认为19世纪最重要的歌剧作曲家之一，与瓦格纳并列为浪漫主义歌剧的两大巨匠。他的作品不仅在音乐史上占有重要地位，也成为意大利文化遗产的重要组成部分。威尔第的名字在意大利文化中具有特殊意义，他的名字首字母V.V.R.D.（Viva Vittorio Re D'Italia）曾被用作意大利统一运动的口号。在流行文化中，威尔第的旋律被广泛引用和改编，出现在电影、广告和流行音乐中。他的歌剧角色和故事情节已成为全球文化共同记忆的一部分，持续影响着当代艺术创作。威尔第的遗产超越了音乐本身，成为意大利民族身份和文化自信的重要象征。
objective.en: From historical and popular culture perspectives, Verdi is widely recognized as one of the most important opera composers of the 19th century, alongside Wagner, considered the two giants of Romantic opera. His works hold significant importance not only in music history but also as an essential part of Italian cultural heritage. Verdi's name carries special significance in Italian culture, with his initials V.V.R.D. (Viva Vittorio Re D'Italia) having been used as a slogan for the Italian unification movement. In popular culture, Verdi's melodies have been widely quoted and adapted, appearing in films, advertisements, and popular music. His opera characters and storylines have become part of global cultural memory, continuing to influence contemporary artistic creation. Verdi's legacy extends beyond music itself, becoming an important symbol of Italian national identity and cultural confidence.

self.zh: 对我而言，音乐必须表达情感，否则它就毫无意义。
self.en: For me, music must express emotion, otherwise it is meaningless.

others.zh: 威尔第的音乐是意大利的灵魂，他的旋律比任何政治宣言都更能团结这个国家。
others.en: Verdi's music is the soul of Italy; his melodies united the country more than any political declaration.
